request.style: English, reverent acoustic ballad, warm tender male vocal, piano, nylon-string guitar, cello, soft strings, quiet and humble, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the night before the Passover, the supper on the board
The one who came from God and was going back to God
Rose up from the table and he laid his robe aside
Took a towel and a basin and he tied the cloth around

[Verse]
He knelt before the fishermen with dust upon their feet
He washed them one by one and dried them with the towel he wore
He came to Simon Peter, who pulled his feet away
You shall never wash my feet
Unless I wash you, you have no share with me
Lord, then not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well

[Chorus]
I have given you an example
So that you also should do as I have done for you
You also ought to wash one another's feet
As I have done for you

[Bridge]
Having loved his own who were in the world
He loved them to the very end
You call me Teacher and Lord, and you are right
No servant is greater than his master
If you know these things, you are blessed when you do them

[Chorus]
I have given you an example
So that you also should do as I have done for you
You also ought to wash one another's feet
As I have done for you

[Outro]
He loved them to the very end
As I have done for you
